'''March 2001 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in New World Manga, Livingston, NJ on 24 March 2001. [[Thomas Hermley-Keen]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1961">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-livingston-nj-24-mar-01d1961/ livingston-nj-24-mar-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 26 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-livingston-nj-24-mar-01d1961/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' New World Manga, Livingston, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Thomas Hermley-Keen]]
